principle: Requested change = authorized change. Everything else = protected.
objective: Establish and prove one perfect Smart Board reference and exact ten-destination sidebar without rewriting protected Smart Note content or changing unrelated architecture.
allowed_scope: Smart Board semantic labels, icons, geometry and border treatment
removal of explicitly forbidden Smart Board UI
sidebar destination set, order, semantic keys and hover colors
removal of Smart Mail New badge/item while preserving Smart Mail
runtime acceptance tests required to prove the above
protected_scope: routing behavior except the existing canonical /intelligence/ runtime mapping
external deployment architecture except the canonical 509 runtime lane

labels: HOW TO USE / HOW TO APPLY
boards.layout: one full-width reference board with vertically stacked sections; never tiled or two-column

forbidden_ui: What, Human, Simple/Simplified, Why/Notice, Naya, Learning, So What, For You
content_policy: Do not rewrite, summarize, invent, or truncate Smart Note content. The renderer may relocate existing canonical source text into the approved visual structure only.
deployment_policy: Only the canonical governed 509 world-class runtime workflow may deploy this public runtime. Acceptance failure blocks release; candidate acceptance is mandatory before deployment.
replication_policy: The current implementation target is one proven reference board. Do not replicate to the remaining canonical Smart Notes until this reference independently passes candidate and post-deploy runtime acceptance.
release_rule: No public deployment is permitted unless governance authorization, execution contract, candidate static acceptance, candidate browser acceptance, and post-deploy browser acceptance all pass.
